name: inspect_android_package
description: Inspect a local APK's package, SDK and permission declarations, decoded manifest and class/resource counts, with a bounded static component projection. Omitted or complete detail preserves the complete result. Select detail: "summary" for all declarations, engine identity and counts without decoded manifest text or duplicate raw calls; retains the complete source and returns a distinct linked inspect_analysis_view summary. With summary detail, optionally select view kind android: facet components supports offset/limit, fields and exact kinds/names/actions/exported filters; source_index preserves the retained parent array ordinal and declaration_coverage preserves historical unknowns. Facet component-summary counts selected kinds and exported declarations separately from defaults. Facet manifest pages exact UTF-16 text. Reuse the same views with inspect_analysis_view and normalized_result.parent_evidence_id; complete detail rejects view selection. Does not execute the APK or verify signatures. Requires a caller-supplied JADX MCP JAR and JDK; uses one worker in an isolated temporary workspace.
